commentary.text: 90+256' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) receives a yellow card!

52' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
51' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) for his blatant foul. PENALTY to Brest! Let's see who will take responsibility.
48' A sweet pass inside the box gives Pathe Mboup (Brest) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Eric Roy gives a chance to Pathe Mboup (Brest) and Mama Balde is off.
46' Stephane Gilli has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Adama Camara (Paris FC) comes on the pitch for Vincent Marchetti.
46' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Mama Balde (Brest) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+1' 3 additional min. will be played.
45+1' Mama Balde (Brest) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
43' The ball is out of play. Brest will have a chance to score from a corner.
40' A wild pass somehow finds Romain Del Castillo (Brest) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
37' Brest take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
34' 0 - 2 Goal 0:2! Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
34' Gregoire Coudert pulls off a great save to deny Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.

32' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Obed Nkambadio makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net.
29' Paris FC failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
29' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. Paris FC get a corner.
25' The linesman makes the right call and Brest will have a corner.

25' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper. Brest force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
24' Good work from Brest as they win a corner.

24' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, and he produces a promising goal-bound header low towards the middle of the goal, but Obed Nkambadio pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
24' Brest will take a free kick.
23' The game has begun to heat up. Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
21' Wonderful movement by Brest. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
14' 0 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Maxime Lopez finds Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
13' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) commits a foul and Bastien Dechepy immediately signals a free kick.
11' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Moses Simon, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
9' Hamidou Makalou (Brest) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Obed Nkambadio scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
9' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
5' Mama Balde (Brest) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' Great teamplay by Brest as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
